mathematical_form: delta S_parent/delta lambda_nu -> nabla_mu R_T^{mu nu}-nabla^nu Gamma_eff=0 and delta S_parent/delta eta -> g_mu_nu R_T^{mu nu}=0
why_it_matters: Without this, R_T is the rejected Div^-1 shortcut.

why_it_matters: A right inverse in one geometry can fail after local projection/readout.

required_clause: Boundary, gauge and Green-function domain are selected before scoring and are not retuned per test.
why_it_matters: The inverse-operator route is nonlocal and boundary-sensitive.

required_clause: The owner/multiplier block has zero or bounded direct local metric response.
mathematical_form: Pi_metric delta S_RI/delta g_loc <= arena budget
why_it_matters: Cancelling q_tr is not enough if the owner block sources PPN/R10/clocks elsewhere.

required_clause: The leftover Delta_K lies in the projected divergence kernel or has finite source-backed arena bounds.
mathematical_form: P_loc nabla_mu Delta_K^{mu nu}=0 or C_DeltaK_div sourced
why_it_matters: The observable channel sees divergence, not trace alone.

required_clause: The same kernel/quarantine theorem must not switch off ordinary matter gravity.
mathematical_form: R_loc T_matter != 0 and reduces to GR/Newton while R_loc q_tr=0
why_it_matters: A projector that kills all local response would also kill the required GR limit.
